_what_this_is: Every blocking finding a gate run made, and the DOCUMENT that settled it. See findings.py: a finding is not evidence, and the quotation below is checked against the bytes.

findings.gate_said: 14 total deaths confirmed; per-arm split of 7 in each arm not found in any source reached
findings.quote: Seven patients died during follow-up in each arm.
findings.why: The gate could not reach a source giving the per-arm split. We hold one that states it outright, and the JCO paper states it as 7 of 107 and 7 of 50.
findings._fill_in: decision: accepted, rejected, judgement. accepted/rejected need source_id AND a quote that is in that document.

findings.gate_said: 49% reduction in risk of recurrence or death (HR 0.51; 95% CI 0.294–0.887) — confirmed in KEYNOTE-942, but from the 5-year update (JCO, June 2026 / 2026 ASCO), not the primary analysis (which showed 44% reduction, HR 0.561)
findings.quote: At 5-year follow-up, intismeran plus pembrolizumab was associated with a 49% reduction in the risk of recurrence or death
findings.why: The gate's concern was conditional: 'if the draft implies this is the primary-analysis figure'. It does not. The page says the figures 'describe a different trial: an open-label study of 157 patients', and this held article shows the 49% is that trial's five-year readout.
findings._fill_in: decision: accepted, rejected, judgement. accepted/rejected need source_id AND a quote that is in that document.

findings.gate_said: Topline press release: December 13, 2022. Lancet online publication: January 18, 2024. Gap: approximately 13 months, not four and a half months.
findings.why: The change-log entry gave a gap that matches no pair of dates we hold. Corrected to the two dates the documents carry: 16 April 2023 (S005) to 18 January 2024 (this record).

findings.gate_said: The 5-year RFS rate for the combination arm is 68.8% (95% CI 56.3%–78.3%), not 72.4% (62.2–80.2); the pembro arm 5-year rate of 49.1% (33.3–63.0) is confirmed. The 72.4% figure with CI 62.2–80.2 appears to be the 4-year landmark rate for the combination arm, while 49.1% (33.3–63.0) is the 5-year rate for the pembro arm — the two figures are from different timepoints.
findings.quote: At 5 years, the recurrence-free survival rate was 68.8% (95% confidence interval [CI] = 56.3%-78.3%) in the combination arm and 49.1% (95% CI = 33.3%-63.0%) in the monotherapy arm.
findings.why: The gate was right and the correction it was checking was mine. The five-year rates are restored, with their intervals, credited to the document that prints them.
findings._fill_in: decision: accepted, rejected, judgement. accepted/rejected need source_id AND a quote that is in that document.

findings.gate_said: The draft attributes specific enumerated omissions to MLQ News but MLQ News does not appear in any verifiable source, making the characterisation of their coverage unverifiable.
findings.quote: The companies have not disclosed hazard ratios, confidence intervals, p-values, median follow-up or event counts for the Phase 3 trial.
findings.why: The gate reported this as unverifiable because no MLQ News article appeared in its search results. WE HOLD THE ARTICLE and it reads exactly as the page said. This is the gate committing MEL-11's error: a finding about its own reach, stated as a finding about the page. The sentence is quoted on the page now so the next run sees it.
findings._fill_in: decision: accepted, rejected, judgement. accepted/rejected need source_id AND a quote that is in that document.

findings.gate_said: The draft makes a significant factual claim about adjuvant PD-1 inhibitors and overall survival without citing any source.
findings.quote: Ipilimumab and Placebo matching Nivolumab
findings.why: The gate was right that a sweeping clinical claim carried no citation. It now carries two registry records, both held. The quotation here is CheckMate 238's own arm label: its comparator is ipilimumab under a matching placebo, not placebo alone, so it cannot report an overall-survival benefit against placebo. KEYNOTE-054 (S020), which IS pembrolizumab against placebo, lists overall survival as a secondary outcome with no data posted and a time frame running to about eleven years.
findings._fill_in: decision: accepted, rejected, judgement. accepted/rejected need source_id AND a quote that is in that document.

It checks out arithmetically and that is not the point. Removed. The paragraph's claim now rests on the registered threshold, which the sources state.
